description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the MembershipDao component of the OrangeHRM system, testing CRUD operations and other methods related to membership data access.

classes.name: MembershipDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the MembershipDao's CRUD operations and membership-related data access methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, instantiates the MembershipDao, sets up test fixture data.

methods.name: testAddMembership
methods.description: Tests adding a new membership and verifies it is saved correctly.

methods.name: testEditMembership
methods.description: Tests editing an existing membership record.

methods.name: testGetMembershipList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of memberships based on search filter.

methods.name: testGetMembershipById
methods.description: Tests fetching a membership by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion with nonexistent membership IDs, expecting zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Tests checking for existing membership names, case-insensitive and with whitespace handling.
